description: This file defines a custom MetaTracer and related classes for symbolic tracing of PyTorch models with meta tensors, including override functions for certain torch operations and classes for proxying tensor attributes.

classes.name: MetaProxy
classes.description: A custom proxy class for tensors that supports meta tensor attributes and overrides.

classes.name: MetaAttribute
classes.description: A proxy class for tensor attributes, lazily creates nodes for attribute access.

classes.name: MetaDeviceAttribute
classes.description: A subclass of MetaAttribute for device attributes.

classes.name: MetaTracer
classes.description: A custom tracer class for symbolic tracing with meta tensors, supporting patching of torch methods and module handling.

methods.name: embedding_override
methods.description: Override for torch.nn.Embedding that returns a meta tensor.

methods.name: nn_layernorm_override
methods.description: Override for torch.nn.LayerNorm that returns input unchanged.

methods.name: torch_relu_override
methods.description: Override for torch.relu that returns input unchanged.

methods.name: torch_nn_relu_override
methods.description: Override for torch.nn.ReLU that returns input unchanged.

methods.name: functional_relu_override
methods.description: Override for functional relu that asserts no inplace operation.

methods.name: torch_where_override
methods.description: Override for torch.where that combines condition, x, y into a meta tensor.

methods.name: torch_abs_override
methods.description: Override for torch.abs that asserts no in-place operation.

methods.name: gen_constructor_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps torch constructor functions to create proxies.

methods.name: symbolic_trace
methods.description: Function to create a symbolic graph of a model or function with meta tensor support.
